questionDescription: Identify the repeated backbone interaction that stabilizes an alpha helix.
prompt: In an alpha helix, a backbone carbonyl oxygen at residue i most commonly hydrogen-bonds with which group?

choices.text: The backbone N-H group at residue i+4
The backbone N-H group at residue i+1

feedback.correct: Correct. The i to i+4 backbone hydrogen-bond pattern is characteristic of an alpha helix.
feedback.incorrect: Trace the repeating backbone hydrogen-bond pattern along the helix.
